A tiny pomodoro timer for macOS: a thin line along the edge of your screen that drains during a tomato and fills back up during a break. Runs on macOS 13 or later, on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

### Install

1. Download **ThakaaliTimer-….zip** below and double-click it to unzip.
2. Drag **Thakaali Timer** into your Applications folder.
3. Open it. macOS will say it can't verify the developer, because the app isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID yet. To allow it:
   - Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to Thakaali Timer. Confirm with your password.
   - On macOS 14 or earlier you can instead right-click the app and choose **Open**.

You only need to do this once. The timer lives in the menu bar; pick **Start Tomato** to begin.
